versions.changelog:
bidding-doc-domain v1.0.0

- Initial release providing a comprehensive bidding document knowledge base.
- Covers six major domains: tender analysis, business document preparation, technical document preparation, pricing document preparation, bid risk control, and global consistency check.
- Includes 22 task types and industry coverage for goods procurement, services, and engineering projects.
- Supplies task lists, dependency topologies, content requirements, and sample placeholders (范本) for standardized bidding workflows.
- Designed as a data/domain package to be used with Universal Task OS (UTOS); read-only reference mode enabled if UTOS is unavailable.
- Clearly documents all required business, technical, and compliance aspects for bid document preparation.
